ScoreRecord.title: ScoreRecord
ScoreRecord.description: An individual game score record belonging to an authenticated player.

userId.description: The UID of the authenticated player who achieved this score.

score.description: Total points scored in the matching puzzle session.

levelReached.description: Highest progressive difficulty level reached in the run.

matchesCount.description: Total target items accurately linked in 10-second steps.

status.description: Terminal status of the score run.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the score record was created.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when the score record was last updated.

GlobalLeaderboard.title: GlobalLeaderboard
GlobalLeaderboard.description: Bounded top-10 global high score board document.

lastUpdatedBy.description: UID of the verified player who last updated the board.

topScore.description: Highest score currently on the board.

entries.description: Bounded list of up to 10 top score map entries.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the board was initialized.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when the board was last updated.

/scores/{scoreId}.description: Stores individual player puzzle runs and personal high scores.

/leaderboards/{boardId}.description: Stores the global top-10 leaderboard summary document.
